# The per-window catalogue of the ALMA 40 pc technosignature search: one row per searched spectral window.
# Accompanies the arXiv submission as an ancillary file (anc/).  Tab-separated; an empty field is a value that does not apply.
# A window is identified by its target identifier, its execution block and its frequency limits; the star column is the designation this star carries in the paper and in the crossing ledger, and joins the two files.
# Every star of the crossing ledger appears here except HD 139084 B, whose extractions are second readings of windows this catalogue counts under HD 139084.
# One row is one searched window and one target identifier is one searched position: there are 90 distinct identifiers over 87 distinct designations, the difference being the components of bound pairs the designation merges, and it is the identifier that the paper's count of searched stars is a count of.
# The crossing flag is the adopted one: 51 of these 1663 windows hold an adopted primary threshold crossing.  The crossing ledger holds 53, the other 2 lying in archival-tail execution blocks outside this catalogue.
#
# Columns:
#   1  star               star name, as in the paper and as in the crossing ledger
#   2  system             system identifier; components of one system share it
#   3  target_id          identifier the window was extracted under; distinguishes the components of a pair observed in one block
#   4  eb                 ALMA execution block (asdm) identifier
#   5  band               ALMA receiver band
#   6  nu_lo_GHz          lower edge of the spectral window, GHz
#   7  nu_hi_GHz          upper edge of the spectral window, GHz
#   8  chan_width_Hz      delivered channel width, Hz
#   9  on_source_s        on-source integration time at this position, s
#  10  rms_mJy            per-channel noise at the extraction position, mJy
#  11  smin_mJy           amplitude limit at the trigger, mJy
#  12  drift_max_Hz_s     largest drift rate searched in this window, Hz/s
#  13  a_max_m_s2         line-of-sight acceleration that corresponds to it, m/s^2
#  14  eirp_p90_W         adopted 90 per cent completeness EIRP limit, W; the smearing retention divided out here is the one measured on the delivered channel response, which is the form the paper adopts, and not the transform-limited sinc form
#  15  eirp_p90_lo_W      lower end of its interval, W: the dispersion measured between the injected windows, the same pair of factors on every row, and not a bound measured in this window's own band and channelisation
#  16  eirp_p90_hi_W      upper end of its interval, W, on the same basis
#  17  dist_pc            distance adopted for the star, pc
#  18  search_class       A where the window resolves a carrier, B where it is coarse
#  19  t_start_mjd        adopted start epoch of the execution block, MJD
#  20  injected           1 where this window carries its own injection ladder, 0 where its EIRP_90 is transferred
#  21  n_ctrl             control positions in this window's ensemble
#  22  n_ctrl_trig        how many of them reach the trigger
#  23  mask_attr_share    share of those exceedances the attribution mask takes, in the star's rest frame
#  24  telluric_factor    factor by which the remaining exceedances are reduced by the atmospheric screen, applied to the crossings on the same radius and in the same topocentric frame
#  25  crossing           1 where this window holds an adopted primary threshold crossing
#  26  disposition        the disposition printed in the crossing ledger, where there is one
#
star	system	target_id	eb	band	nu_lo_GHz	nu_hi_GHz	chan_width_Hz	on_source_s	rms_mJy	smin_mJy	drift_max_Hz_s	a_max_m_s2	eirp_p90_W	eirp_p90_lo_W	eirp_p90_hi_W	dist_pc	search_class	t_start_mjd	injected	n_ctrl	n_ctrl_trig	mask_attr_share	telluric_factor	crossing	disposition
